verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions dedicated IPs, IP warmup, automated ramp-up, or a published warmup schedule. The only IP-related item is blocklist monitoring of sending domains and IPs, which is an adjacent feature and does not deliver dedicated IP provisioning or warmup. Dedicated IPs are a fair question for a transactional email service, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can get dedicated IPs with documented warmup — automated ramp-up or a published warmup schedule — when my volume outgrows shared pools
